text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith35(x) ::: x's license plate begins with the number 35.
BeginsWith34(x) ::: x's license plate begins with the number 34.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.

Premises:
∀x (¬BeginsWith35(x) → FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not beginning with 35 are from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(Joe) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith35(Tom) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginsWith35(x) → ¬BeginsWith34(x)) ::: If a license plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.

Conclusion:
BeginsWith34(Joe) ::: Joe's license plate begins with the number 34.
